processes.name: Dealer Quoting & Order Intake
processes.description: Receives dealer requests via phone or email, validates the dealer ID against an Excel list, captures model/dimensions/options in a quote template, and routes exceptional pricing to the sales manager for approval before sending a dated offer.
pain_points: Manual re-keying of quote data into the order register
Excel-based pricing formulas require manual maintenance and exception handling
Credit status checks rely on unspecified Excel records rather than automated flags

processes.name: Production Scheduling & Shop Floor Management
processes.description: Assigns unique work-order IDs and target dates to accepted dealer orders, sequences confirmed WOs in Excel and on a shop whiteboard based on stock notes and supervisor input, and distributes paper build packets to fabrication and assembly crews.
pain_points: Target dates are estimates, not guarantees, causing dealer expectation gaps
Excel schedule lacks real-time floor visibility or automated alerts
Material shortages cause worker idle time before reassignment to other work

processes.name: Purchasing, Receiving & Inventory Control
processes.description: Manages weekly cycle counts of selected SKUs, approves purchase orders, coordinates receiving bay checks against POs, and updates Excel stock sheets while matching supplier bills in QuickBooks for accounting entry.
pain_points: Discrepancy between Excel shop-floor stock sheet and QuickBooks accounting records
Manual paper receiving slips and partial deliveries delay inventory updates
Limited competitive re-quoting for critical components like axles

processes.name: Fabrication, Assembly & Quality Inspection
processes.description: Executes cutting, welding, painting, and final assembly per paper build packets; supervisors report progress or material exceptions to the scheduler; quality lead verifies spec revisions, checks compliance of substitutions (brakes, tires, lighting), and signs the final inspection checklist.
pain_points: Manual packet page replacements for spec changes risk version confusion
Strict compliance review required for every component substitution
Final inspection checklist stays with the paper WO, risking separation from digital records

processes.name: Shipping, Invoicing & Dealer Support
processes.description: Schedules trailer shipment, sends confirmation to accounting for QuickBooks invoice generation at shipment, and handles dealer status inquiries by checking the order register and coordinating with the scheduler or shipping coordinator.
pain_points: Manual status checks require cross-department coordination and email trails
Revenue recognition lags behind shipment due to net-30 terms and tax exclusions
No separate freight charge complicates cost tracking and dealer billing clarity

processes.name: Warranty Claims Processing
processes.description: Receives dealer warranty reports, forwards model/VIN/problem details to the quality lead, opens a claim ID, verifies inspection records, approves dealer repairs before work begins, and closes claims upon completion evidence.
pain_points: No blanket coverage policy requires case-by-case review and documentation
Single point of failure for repair approvals if the quality lead is unavailable
VINs are often missing from sample claims, complicating trailer tracking
